title: Little Archie #119 Archie Comics 1977 Circus of Thrills Little Sabrina
condition_description: Cover wear and light creasing, light soiling; small pen mark on the back cover at the top right. See photos.
description:
Little Archie #119 (June 1977), Archie Comics - the Circus of Thrills: Little Archie joins a clown act, plus the daring Masked Marvel and a Little Sabrina story. 35 cent cover price, newsstand edition.

Back cover: Popsicle "Have a Ball" Sweepstakes ad (Greyhound bus).

Condition: cover wear with light creasing and light soiling; small pen mark on the back cover at the top right (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
